mergers.entity: Aadhi Shakti Bidhyut Bikash Co. Ltd. (ASBL) — Tadi Khola 5MW, wholly-owned subsidiary
mergers.status: Absorbed into MEN, Bhadra 28 2075 BS. Not an arm-length acquisition — ASBL was already MEN's own subsidiary; accounted for under NFRS Acquisition Method (goodwill recognized), 4,205,987 shares issued jointly for both entities.

mergers.entity: Robust Energy Ltd. (REL) — Mistri Khola 42MW, wholly-owned subsidiary
mergers.status: Absorbed into MEN, Bhadra 28 2075 BS, while Mistri Khola was still under construction. Not an arm-length acquisition — REL was already MEN's own subsidiary; MEN had no subsidiaries left after. Source: MEN 7th/8th Annual Reports; corroborated by CARE Ratings Nepal (Mar 2024).
